events.summary: Patch notes can also be read here: https://5yearsnow.com/games/5YN-OS/patch/v0.1.2-demoGeneralAdded gamepad controls for the desktop and Doomlike, including a virtual cursor, window controls, scrolling, and text entry.Added remappable controller buttons, cursor speed, and deadzone settings. events.title: Dev Log 10 - Build a Desktop Widget in FantasyLang
events.summary: Three lines get a chromeless window running on your desktop. A dozen more make it visible. About a hundred make it a registered widget that draws, remembers where you put it, has a right-click menu, and can be published to the Workshop.Read Dev Log 10 in full here: https://5yn-os.com/blog/blog-post-01-09-2026

events.title: Dev Log 9 - Nine Games Inside an Operating System, and You Can Read Their Source
events.summary: A roguelike, an idle guild sim, an autobattler, tower defence, poker, a logic simulator, a desktop pet, noughts and crosses, and a Doom-like. Eight of the nine are written in the operating system's own language, and they are sitting in your file system right now. Read the full blog post here: https://5yn-os.com/blog/blog-post-28-08-2026

events.title: Dev Log 7 - Killing the Start Menu: Designing the Spider Web
events.summary: A Start menu is a list pretending to be a place. I wanted an actual place - so the launcher in 5YN-OS is a web you navigate outward from a centre, and the window manager underneath it had to be good enough to justify the decision.Read the full blog post here: https://5yn-os.com/blog/blog-post-21-08-2026

events.title: Dev Log 6 - Learning to Program by Being Handed a Computer
events.summary: Dev Academy does not give you exercises. It gives you a machine, a reason to use it, and fifty-three steps that add up to one working full-stack project - an app, a website, a server, a database, and a commit history. Read the full blog post here: https://5yn-os.com/blog/blog-post-18-08-2026
